downpour_data/.titanium.db: SQLite main database (WAL mode). Tables: malicious_urls (108k), malicious_ips (425k), malicious_hashes (54k), malicious_domains (316k), safe_files, quarantine, threat_families (27), threat_history, process_behaviors, port_scan_events, rat_detections, surveillance_events, c2_detections, parental_log, ransomware_events, file_snapshots, rollback_operations, memory_injection_events (205), feed_status (354), canary_files, network_events, scan_history.
downpour_data/.quarantine/quarantine.db: SQLite quarantine database (23 entries). Columns: id, original_path, quarantine_path, file_hash, file_size, threat_type, threat_name, severity, quarantined_at, original_dacl, original_sacl, original_owner, created_time, modified_time, accessed_time, restored, restored_at, restore_verified.
downpour_data/.ultimate_threat_intel.db: SQLite database for aggregated indicators. Tables: indicators (value, indicator_type, category, subcategory, severity, confidence, source, description, tags, metadata, first_seen, last_seen), feed_status (feed_id, last_update, last_success, records_added, records_total, status).
downpour_data/.vulnerability_scanner.db: SQLite database for CVEs and installed software. Tables: vulnerabilities (1734 rows), software_inventory (84k rows), exploit_attempts (606 rows), system_vulnerabilities (20.5M pairs), kev_catalog (1695 rows), epss_scores, cwe_mapping, threat_actor_vulns, vulnerability_trends, patch_priority_queue.
downpour_data/.memory_forensics.db: SQLite database for memory analysis. Tables: memory_analysis (98 rows), injection_events, memory_snapshots.
downpour_data/.threat_intel.db: SQLite database for domain/hash intelligence. Tables: malicious_domains (10.4k rows), malware_hashes (5.6k rows), mitre_attack_techniques (858 rows), malicious_ips, malicious_urls, feed_updates.
downpour_data/.threat_actors.db: SQLite database for actor intelligence. Tables: threat_actors, actor_indicators, actor_malware, actor_cves.
baselines_json: cisa_kev.json: Cached CISA KEV catalog (1.4 MB, 1200+ CVEs)
cis_immune_state.json: Cognitive Immune System detector statistics and memory (156 KB)
code_integrity.json: Signed SHA-256 baseline hashes for all Python modules (24 KB)
hosts_baseline.json: Hosts file baseline entries (2.9 MB)
dns_baseline.json: TOFU DNS resolver cache baseline (52 KB)
fw_rules_baseline.json: Windows Firewall rule baseline snapshot (8 KB)
persistence_baseline.json: Scheduled task and Run key baseline (11 KB)
service_binpath_baseline.json: Windows service binary path baseline (25 KB)
comhijack_baseline.json: COM registration CLSID baseline (1 KB)
exploitdb/exploitdb_index.json: Exploit-DB metadata and exploit index (25.7 MB)
honeytokens/canary_registry.json: Active canary files and verification hashes (56 KB)
quarantine/manifests/*.json: 23 individual JSON quarantine descriptor manifests matching quarantine.db
models/: model_anomaly.pkl: Scikit-learn anomaly detection model trained on benign system behavior
scaler.pkl: StandardScaler transformation for model_anomaly feature vectors

v29DiskStores.downpour_v27_data/: Legacy v27 data directory with prior version configuration and history.

nextDecision.quarantine: Migrate quarantine manifests (downpour_data/quarantine/) into Downpour Next QuarantineManager with read-only inspection first; restoration requires explicit user elevation and DN-008 broker.
nextDecision.threatIntelAndFeeds: Do not copy raw 400k+ SQLite rows directly. Re-fetch validated feeds using Downpour Next's bounded clients (KevCatalogClient, FIRST EPSS, NVD Client, URLhaus, Abuse.ch) with strict schema validation and SHA-256 caching.
nextDecision.baselines: TOFU (Trust On First Use) baselines must be captured freshly on the current Windows host via Service providers rather than copying machine-specific v29 JSONs.
nextDecision.settings: Migrate relevant user OSINT API keys and display preferences into DPAPI-protected settings storage. Do not migrate bypass_tpm_bitlocker.
nextDecision.logsAndCache: Discard legacy app.log, crash_fault.log, and downpour_tmp (4153 temp files). Downpour Next uses structured EventSource and SQLite OperationJournal v2.
